papers.title: GlazyBench: A Benchmark for Ceramic Glaze Property Prediction and Image Generation
papers.authors: Ziyu Zhai, Siyou Li, Juexi Shao, Juntao Yu
papers.affiliations: Queen Mary University of London
papers.intro: 提出GlazyBench，首个面向陶瓷釉料设计的标准化基准数据集，支持原料到烧后表面性能预测以及基于性能的图像生成两大任务，并建立了全面的基线模型。

papers.title: DPM++: Dynamic Masked Metric Learning for Occluded Person Re-identification
papers.authors: Lei Tan, Yingshi Luan, Pincong Zou, Pingyang Dai, Liujuan Cao
papers.affiliations: Key Laboratory of Multimedia Trusted Perception and Efficient Computing, Ministry of Education of China, Xiamen University
papers.intro: 本文提出 DPM++，一个动态掩码度量学习框架，通过CLIP引导的语义先验注入、显著性引导的补丁传输合成真实遮挡样本，以及输入自适应的原型掩码匹配，实现了遮挡行人重识别的SOTA性能。

papers.title: DPM++: Dynamic Masked Metric Learning for Occluded Person Re-identification
papers.authors: Lei Tan, Yingshi Luan, Pincong Zou, Pingyang Dai, Liujuan Cao
papers.affiliations: Key Laboratory of Multimedia Trusted Perception and Efficient Computing, Ministry of Education of China, Xiamen University, P.R. China
papers.intro: 论文提出DPM++，一个动态掩码度量学习框架，通过输入自适应的原型掩码在CLIP语义增强的类原型空间中实现遮挡行人的局部到整体可见一致性匹配，并利用显著性引导的补丁迁移合成真实遮挡样本以强化训练。

papers.title: SoftSAE: Dynamic Top-K Selection for Adaptive Sparse Autoencoders
papers.authors: Jakub Stępień, Marcin Mazur, Jacek Tabor, Przemysław Spurek
papers.affiliations: Jagiellonian University（前三作者）；Przemysław Spurek 还隶属于 IDEAS Research Institute
papers.intro: 本文提出 SoftSAE，利用可微的 Soft Top-K 算子，通过一个动态稀疏度预测网络为每个输入自适应地选择激活特征的数量，无需全局固定稀疏参数，实现了更匹配数据复杂度的特征分解。

papers.title: DINORANKCLIP: DINOv3 Distillation and Injection for Vision-Language Pretraining with High-Order Ranking Consistency
papers.authors: Shuyang Jiang, Nan Yu, Yiming Zhang, Zenghui Ding, Zhenyu Wu
papers.affiliations: UCLA, Aimaikj, HFIPS/CAS, USTC, NUDT
papers.intro: DINORANKCLIP通过冻结DINOv3教师的知识蒸馏与冲突感知融合注入密集局部结构先验，并引入高阶Plackett-Luce排序模型（包含二阶、三阶过渡项），在72小时CC3M训练中一致超越CLIP、CyCLIP、ALIP和RANKCLIP，特别是在细粒度和分布外评测上取得最大相对提升。

papers.title: MedHorizon: Towards Long-context Medical Video Understanding in the Wild
papers.authors: Bodong Du, Bowen Liu, Yang Yu, Xinpeng Ding, Zhiheng Wu, Shuning Wang, Shuo Nie, Naiming Liu, Qifeng Chen, Yangqiu Song, Xiaomeng Li
papers.affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Baidu Inc., Xidian University
papers.intro: MedHorizon 是一个面向野外现场的长上下文医疗视频理解基准，包含759小时完整手术和检查视频、1253个证据驱动的多选问题，揭示了当前多模态大模型在极端稀疏证据场景下仅达到41.1%准确率，并诊断出检索瓶颈、注意力漂移等核心缺陷。

papers.title: DCR: Counterfactual Attractor Guidance for Rare Compositional Generation
papers.authors: Taewon Kang, Matthias Zwicker
papers.affiliations: University of Maryland at College Park, United States
papers.intro: 提出Default Completion Repulsion (DCR)，一种训练免费框架，通过构造反事实吸引器揭示模型的默认完成倾向，并在去噪过程中用投影内嵌排斥机制抑制该倾向，从而在不重新训练或修改架构的情况下显著提升稀有组合生成的保真度。

papers.title: FreeSpec: Training-Free Long Video Generation via Singular-Spectrum Reconstruction
papers.authors: Fangda Chen, Shanshan Zhao, Longrong Yang, Chuanfu Xu, Zhigang Luo, Long Lan
papers.affiliations: National University of Defense Technology; Alibaba International Digital Commerce; Zhejiang University; Xiangjiang Laboratory
papers.intro: FreeSpec 提出一种基于奇异谱重建的训练自由长视频生成框架，通过奇异值分解将全局分支作为低秩谱指导、局部分支作为高秩重建基，在避免预定义成分划分的同时，同时保持长程一致性和丰富的空间细节与时间动态。

papers.title: MARBLE: Multi-Aspect Reward Balance for Diffusion RL
papers.authors: Canyu Zhao, Hao Chen, Yunze Tong, Yu Qiao, Jiacheng Li, Chunhua Shen
papers.affiliations: 1 Zhejiang University, 2 HiThink, 3 Zhejiang University of Technology
papers.intro: MARBLE 提出一种梯度空间的多奖励平衡框架，通过逐奖励优势分解、梯度归一化与二次规划协调，在不依赖手动权重的情况下同时提升所有奖励维度，并利用摊销公式将训练成本降至接近单奖励基线。

papers.title: GeoStack: A Framework for Quasi-Abelian Knowledge Composition in VLMs
papers.authors: Pranav Mantini, Shishir K. Shah
papers.affiliations: University of Houston；The University of Oklahoma
papers.intro: GeoStack提出一种模块化知识组合框架，通过为每个领域训练带有几何约束（上三角闭包和正交性损失）的适配器（GeoLayers），使得多个独立训练的专家可以通过矩阵乘法顺序堆叠并折叠为单一权重，实现常数时间O(1)的推理复杂度，显著缓解灾难性遗忘。

papers.title: FREPix: Frequency-Heterogeneous Flow Matching for Pixel-Space Image Generation
papers.authors: Mingfeng Lin, Jiakun Chen, Liang Han, Liqiang Nie
papers.affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen)
papers.intro: 本文提出FREPix，一个频率异构流匹配框架，通过将像素空间图像显式分解为低频和高频分量，分配异构插值路径，使用解耦网络分别预测，并设计频率对齐目标函数，将粗到细生成从隐式行为转变为显式设计原则，在ImageNet上实现竞争性FID（256×256: 1.91, 512×512: 2.38）且在低N…

papers.title: Reconstruction or Semantics? What Makes a Latent Space Useful for Robotic World Models
papers.authors: Nilaksh, Saurav Jha, Artem Zholus, Sarath Chandar
papers.affiliations: ¹Chandar Research Lab; ²Mila – Quebec AI Institute; ³Polytechnique Montréal; ⁴Canada CIFAR AI Chair
papers.intro: 本文通过固定DiT过渡模型和训练协议，系统比较六种重建和语义编码器在BridgeV2数据集上的动作条件LDM，发现语义潜在空间在动作可恢复性、任务成功分类、CEM规划以及策略环内成功率上均优于重建空间，证明视觉保真度不是世界模型选择的唯一标准。

papers.title: Empirical Evidence for Simply Connected Decision Regions in Image Classifiers
papers.authors: Arjhun Swaminathan, Mete Akgün
papers.affiliations: University of Tübingen (Medical Data Privacy and Privacy-preserving Machine Learning, Institute for Bioinformatics and Medical Informatics)
papers.intro: 本文提出一种迭代四边形网格填充过程，在有限分辨率下为给定环路构建标签保持的表面，并通过多种现代图像分类器上的实验提供了决策区域是单连通的实证证据。

papers.title: Continuous-Time Distribution Matching for Few-Step Diffusion Distillation
papers.authors: Tao Liu, Hao Yan, Mengting Chen, Taihang Hu, Zhengrong Yue, Zihao Pan, Jinsong Lan, Xiaoyong Zhu, Ming-Ming Cheng, Bo Zheng, Yaxing Wang
papers.affiliations: 1VCIP, College of Computer Science, Nankai University; 2Alibaba Group; 3College of Artificial Intelligence, Jilin University
papers.intro: 本文提出连续时间分布匹配（CDM），首次将DMD从离散时间锚点迁移到连续优化空间，通过动态连续时间调度和速度驱动的离轨对齐损失，在不需要GAN或奖励模型的条件下实现高保真的少步文本到图像生成。

papers.title: SwiftI2V: Efficient High-Resolution Image-to-Video Generation via Conditional Segment-wise Generation
papers.authors: YaoYang Liu, Yuechen Zhang, Wenbo Li, Yufei Zhao, Rui Liu, Long Chen
papers.affiliations: HKUST, CUHK, Joy Future Academy, HKU, HUAWEI Research, HKUST (Long Chen为通讯作者)
papers.intro: SwiftI2V通过两阶段条件分段生成（CSG），在2K分辨率下实现与端到端基线相当的性能，同时总GPU时间减少202倍，并可在单张消费级GPU（如RTX 4090）上运行。

papers.title: TinyBayes: Closed-Form Bayesian Inference via Jacobi Prior for Real-Time Image Classification on Edge Devices
papers.authors: Shouvik Sardar, Sourish Das
papers.affiliations: Data Science Group, Chennai Mathematical Institute, Data Science Group, Chennai Mathematical Institute
papers.intro: 本论文提出了TinyBayes，首个将闭式贝叶斯分类器（基于雅可比先验的分布式多项回归）与移动级计算机视觉流水线（YOLOv8-Nano检测+MobileNetV3-Small特征提取）相结合的框架，在<9.5 MB的模型总大小和<150 ms的CPU端到端推理时间下，实现了78.7%的分类准确率，…

papers.title: Render, Don't Decode: Weight-Space World Models with Latent Structural Disentanglement
papers.authors: Roussel Desmond Nzoyem, Mauro Comi
papers.affiliations: University of Manchester, University of Bristol
papers.intro: 提出NOVA框架，首次在隐式神经表征（INR）的权重空间中构建世界模型，通过结构化潜在分解（背景、前景、运动）实现无解码器渲染、零样本超分辨率和可编辑视频生成。

papers.title: Eulerian Motion Guidance: Robust Image Animation via Bidirectional Geometric Consistency
papers.authors: Thong Nguyen, Khoi M. Le, Cong-Duy Nguyen, Luu Anh Tuan, See-Kiong Ng, Chunyan Miao
papers.affiliations: 新加坡国立大学、VinUniversity、南洋理工大学
papers.intro: 本文提出欧拉运动引导（Eulerian Motion Guidance）框架，通过使用相邻帧的光流替代参考帧光流来指导生成，并引入双向几何一致性机制过滤遮挡区域，从而获得更鲁棒的时间一致性和更少的动态伪影。

papers.title: When Labels Have Structure: Improving Image Classification with Hierarchy-Aware Cross-Entropy
papers.authors: April Chan, Davide D'Ascenzo, Sebastiano Cultrera di Montesano
papers.affiliations: 麻省理工学院（MIT）、米兰大学（University of Milan）、都灵理工大学（Politecnico di Torino）、博德研究所（Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard）
papers.intro: 本文提出Hierarchy-Aware Cross-Entropy (HACE)，一种即插即用的损失函数，通过同时修改预测分布（预测聚合）和目标分布（祖先标签平滑），将类别层次结构直接编码进交叉熵中，在三个层次数据集和六种架构上相比标准交叉熵平均提升4.66%的端到端准确率。

papers.title: Spark3R: Asymmetric Token Reduction Makes Fast Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Zecheng Tang, Jiaye Fu, Qiankun Gao, Haijie Li, Yanmin Wu, Jiaqi Zhang, Siwei Ma, Jian Zhang
papers.affiliations: Zecheng Tang, Jiaye Fu, Qiankun Gao, Haijie Li, Yanmin Wu, and Jian Zhang 为 School of Electronic and Computer Engineering, Peking University, Shenzhen 518055, China；Jiaqi Zhang and Siwei Ma 为 School of Computer Science, Peking University, Beijing 100871, China。
papers.intro: 本文提出Spark3R，一个无需重新训练、即插即用的加速框架，通过非对称地压缩query token（采用组内合并）和key‑value token（采用轻量剪枝），并引入逐层自适应的key‑value缩减调度，在预训练的前馈3D重建模型（VGGT、π³、Depth‑Anything‑3）上实现最高…
